title: Yellowed Yeasty Australian Treacle Flatbread
description: A traditional Australian dish featuring treacle and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for curing hangovers, this flatbread is briny, aerated, and FODMAP-friendly. It is made with a simple ingredients list and is easy to prepare.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, sugar, and warm water, then let it sit for 10 minutes until the mixture becomes frothy.
Add treacle, olive oil, salt, and sea salt to the bowl, then mix until well combined.
Gradually add rice flour to the bowl, mixing until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and shape it into a flat round.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25 minutes until it is golden brown.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
